title: fmri-variogram-analysis: replication code

creators.name: Arhin, Godfred
creators.affiliation: The University of Texas at El Paso

description:
Replication code for What a Variogram on a Voxel Lattice Can and Cannot Determine: Non-Parametric Estimation, an Interpolation Signature, and the Limits of Cluster-Extent Calibration.

The archive carries the code and nothing else: every script behind every table and figure in the paper, and a manifest naming the script and the inputs behind each one. It is built from the GitHub repository at the tagged release, so the two cannot diverge.

No data is distributed. The chain starts from the public dataset ds005891, and its imaging stage needs MATLAB with SPM, about 132 GB of disk, and the stimulus-presentation logs, which are not in the OpenNeuro release. The analysis and output stages run in R from the intermediates that stage writes; the output stage regenerates every table and figure in seconds. See the README for the run order and for what reproduces.
